name: Envision Page Builder – WordPress Gutenberg Blocks
author: Plugin Envision

sections.description:
🌟 Learn More Buy Now 🌟

Envision Page Builder is a powerful solution for designing modern websites with WordPress. Seamlessly integrated into the block editor, this plugin enhances your design experience by providing an extensive library of custom Gutenberg blocks. Whether you’re a blogger, small business owner, or designer, Envision Page Builder gives you the tools to create visually stunning websites without touching a single line of code. Designed with ease of use in mind, this page builder is perfect for beginners but also offers advanced features for experienced developers.

As the leading Gutenberg builder, Envision Page Builder focuses on versatility and functionality. Use our collection of unique blocks to create interactive, dynamic, and professional pages. From responsive design features that adapt beautifully to all devices to animations that bring your content to life, this page builder will keep your website looking modern and performing at its best. With an extensive icon library and SEO-friendly design built in, your website will function even better, and the block editor gives you everything you need to create a compelling web presence.

Envision Page Builder is the ultimate choice for anyone wanting to unlock the full potential of Gutenberg blocks. Its flexibility and user-friendly interface make it easy to customize every aspect of your website. Whether you’re designing an elegant portfolio, a vibrant blog, or a professional business website, the plugin’s intuitive block editor makes the process seamless. Designed for performance, Envision Page Builder not only helps you create a visually appealing website but also ensures that your website loads quickly and ranks highly in search engines. Unleash the power of the true Gutenberg builder and transform your WordPress site with Envision Page Builder today!

🌟 Unlock More Flexibility! Use the Blocks to ShortCode plugin to convert blocks into shortcodes and embed them anywhere! 🚀

Envision Page Builder Features

  • Custom Blocks: A variety of unique blocks to enhance your site.
  • Responsive Design: Ensure your site looks good on all devices.
  • Animation: Animate your blocks while scrolling.
  • Icon Library: Apply the icons from various libraries.
  • SEO Friendly: Optimized for search engines.

Envision Page Builder Pro Features

  • Button Block: Check out the pro features of the Button Block.
  • Animation: Unlock advanced features of animation on scroll option.

How to use Envision Page Builder

  • First, install the Envision Page Builder plugin.
  • Add blocks from the Envision Builder category in the Gutenberg editor.
  • Adjust the settings in the settings sidebar on the right.
  • Enjoy!

For installation assistance, click on the Installation tab.

Feedbacks

Was this plugin useful to you? Or do you have any concerns? Have a feature request? Send us your feedback
sections.installation:
Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Envision Page Builder plugin (.zip file).
  2. In the admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New.
  3. Click on Upload Plugin, and choose the envision-page-builder.zip file, and click on Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I get started with this plugin?

It’s very easy! Just install the plugin and add the block to your Gutenberg block editor page.

Is this plugin compatible with my current theme?

This plugin is compatible with most themes. However, if you encounter any issues, feel free to contact us. Our support team will try their best to help you resolve any compatibility issues.

How do I customize the look of the plugin?

After you add a block, you will see a sidebar on the right where you can customize the block you selected.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

You can post any questions in our support forum here.
